title: Generative Data Studio
summary: A Python toolkit that imputes missing values, generates synthetic tabular data, profiles both datasets, and uses an LLM to produce an AI-driven quality validation report. It uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with a SingleTableMetadata object to fit on real data and sample synthetic rows.
evidence: src/synthesizer.py: metadata = SingleTableMetadata(); synthesizer = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata, epochs=100); synthesizer.fit(data); synthesizer.sample(num_rows)
